name: pmcro-reasoning-strategy
description: 35 reasoning strategy agents plus 1 selector agent across 7 families, exposed as 2 parameterized command skills. Migrated from .agents/skills/reasoning/*/SKILL.md. Renamed from the interim 'reasoning-strategy' / 'dynamic-reasoning' folder names.

skills.name: select-reasoning-strategy
skills.description: Recommend one strategy id for a task (arg: task_description, allowed_families?, caller_id?).

skills.name: apply-reasoning-strategy
skills.description: Execute a named strategy against an input and return a ReasoningTraceFrame (arg: strategy_id, input, context?).

notes: pmcro-csuite's select-reasoning-strategy and govern-domain-intent skills delegate here rather than duplicating selection logic.
Never invents a strategy id absent from agents/.
Governed by L-EVIDENCE, L-CHECKER-GATE, L-PLUGIN-ISOLATION, L-OUTPUT-CONTRACT.
